styles: 100 BPM, D minor, steady tempo all the way through
huge tribal war drums, taiko and floor toms
dark Afro-funk baritone sax, trumpet and growling trombone
gritty overdriven guitar kept low in the mix, short muted stabs
raw dry live band recording in one room

sections.text:
[Intro]
{tribal war drums pound alone, then the gritty bass joins}

[Verse]
{tribal drums and gritty bass lock a driving groove, a quiet muted guitar stab now and then, the horns rest}

[Chorus]
{the whole band at full force, brutal baritone sax and trumpet blasts lead, overdriven guitar chords under them, crashing cymbals}

[Break]
{stop-time: the whole band slams one chord together on beat one of each bar and lets it ring, silence between the hits}
styles: drums and bass drop out between hits
